description: Cute cartoon armored horse rearing on hind legs, tan coat with flowing cream mane and tail, silver and pale-blue crystal-gemmed barding on head chest and hooves, blue swirling cloth drape, wind-swirl and floating feathers around it, rolling green grassy hill under bright blue sky with soft mountains, clean bold ink outlines, flat cel-shaded coloring, whimsical storybook style, warm daylight lighting.
